messages:
priya: Hey team — quick escalation from Support: acct acme-889's trial activation is stuck at the "waiting for resources" step. Customer reports provisioning never completes after they submit keys. We tried a manual restart, same result. :warning:

evansupport-bot: @priya forwarded to #support with logs (INC-5423)

priya: paste logs:
```
2024-01-05T09:12:01Z ERROR provisioning: failed to allocate GPU: insufficient capacity in eu-west-1
2024-01-05T09:12:02Z WARN auth: token exchange returned 502
```

ev an (evan): Can you confirm the model and plan? If they're on trial, they might hit region limits.

priya: They're on "Starter trial" w/ 1 reserved slot, model: redwood-meduim-open, region: eu-west-1. Customer started trial yesterday, onboarding call tomorrow CET.

marisol: Renewal check — this account has a contract review in 28 days (auto-renew opportunity). If activation fails, risk of churn goes up. We need a quick comms plan and an enablement bridge (short remedy session).

ash: Technical suggestion: provision a temporary fallback in us-west-2 and route via smart-routing for now. Also rotate to a canary token to avoid quota collision. I can open the infra override if CS approves.

priya: @marisol yes please own the customer comms. @ash please open the override ticket. I'll join the debug call with @evan at 09:40 CET.

cs-bot: Ticket created: INF-override-9987, priority: high, approver: infra-oncall. ETA 45m.

marisol: Draft comms to send after we have an ETA (short + transparent):
- Acknowledge the issue and immediate steps we're taking (temporary region route + infra override)
- Offer a live 15-min debugging session during onboarding call to keep them on track
- Set expectations: we'll aim to restore normal region in 24h and follow up with root cause

priya: Ping from Support: customer is available for a quick call now. Can we do 10 mins?

evan: I'm hopping in. Quick checklist I'm running: token validity, region quota, stack trace from agent, and provisioning retry log.

ash: I've requested the override; infra said "standby" for capacity check. If approved we'll flip routing.

marisol: I'll prepare a concise email template and a 1-slide playbook for the enablement call (activation bridge). Link to internal playbook: https://redwood.internal/cs/playbooks/activation-bridge (use only for customer-facing summary).

priya: Also logging this as a renewal risk. Tagging account for 1:1 outreach if activation not resolved before call.

evan: Update: token exchange 502 seems transient, retry succeeded once then failed. I'm continuing a live trace. If routing change happens we should see immediate progress.

cs-bot: INF-override-9987 status: awaiting infra approval (ticket updated at 1704500120).

marisol: If override completes, I'll send the short comms and offer two time slots for follow-up enablement: Tue 09:00 CET or Wed 15:00 CET. Prefer Tue to keep onboarding momentum.

priya: Thanks. I'll be on the call and will log customer sentiment notes (NPS-ish). After call we'll decide if this moves to proactive success plan.

ash: Infra approved override. Routing flip scheduled in 2m.

ev an: saw provisioning success events — customer session started. I'm staying on until handoff complete.

priya: Great work all. Next actions:
- @marisol send comms + offer Tue slot (if they accept, schedule enablement)
- @ash confirm routing revert timeline and file postmortem action items
- @evan add a short tech note to the ticket about the 502 token exchange and retry behavior

marisol: Copy — I'll send the comms now and attach the one-slide playbook. :email:

priya: Closing the escalation here, will update renewal flag if we see further issues. Thanks team :sparkles:
